newsitem.title: GREECE: PIRAEUS INVEST H1 PROFIT UP 292PCT.
newsitem.headline: PIRAEUS INVEST H1 PROFIT UP 292PCT.

text.p: Closed-end fund Piraeus Investments , a subsidiary of Piraeus Bank , said its half-year profit grew 292 percent year-on-year to 1.302 billion drachmas.
As of the end of June 1997, its portfolio had unrealised capital gains of 378 million drachmas, excluding sizeable unrealised gains from unlisted equities, it said.
On the same date, its net asset value (NAV) per share stood at 1,327 drachmas, trading at a discount of 8.5 percent to its market price of 1,450 drachmas.
Around 97 percent of Piraeus Investment's portfolio was invested in equities, it said.

Domestic securities accounted for 74.8 percent of its assets, with foreign securities and derivative products making up 24.5 and 0.7 percent, respectively. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
